geopolitics_summary: Von der Leyen Commission pivoting toward climate/AI/industrial policy; Norway escalates Arctic drilling push; US tightens Iran sanctions amid regional instability.

themes.headline: EU Industrial Accelerator Act: France-Germany split on clean manufacturing
themes.why_it_matters: Framework dispute over carbon regulation and industrial subsidies directly affects EUA demand signals, power-intensive production costs, and competitiveness of EU power-to-X / decarbonization capex.

themes.headline: Norway escalates Arctic oil and gas drilling push against EU climate moralizing
themes.why_it_matters: Norwegian supply expansion threatens EU gas scarcity premium; increased Arctic volumes could cap TTF winter prices and reduce incentive for LNG imports and power-to-gas conversion.

themes.headline: US tightens Iran sanctions; Trump administration escalates economic pressure campaign
themes.why_it_matters: Intensified Iran sanctions risk crude supply shocks; indirect EU exposure via LNG arbitrage (tighter global oil market compresses LNG-to-EU economics, supporting TTF via lower displacement).

themes.headline: Dangote refinery boosts Nigeria petroleum product exports sevenfold since 2023
themes.why_it_matters: Increased African refined product supply eases global oil tightness, moderating crude and refined fuel costs; lower heating oil / diesel prices reduce EU power plant fuel-switch incentives.

themes.headline: EU climate chief warns of mounting disaster costs from summer heat, drought, wildfires
themes.why_it_matters: Repeat weather extremes (droughts, heatwaves, fires) underscore hydro scarcity and cooling demand risk; signals toward massive climate-adaptation spend that may compete with grid resilience / storage capex.

watchlist: Von der Leyen State of the Union speech (climate & AI pillars) — watch for decarbonization spending targets, power-to-X roadmap updates.
EU Industrial Accelerator Act negotiation outcome (France-Germany carbon regulation friction) — may reshape EUA floor / cap-and-trade design.
Iranian sanctions escalation timeline — monitor for crude supply shocks and LNG arbitrage repricing.
Norwegian Arctic drilling permits & timeline — assess impact on European gas contract curves (winter 26–27 premiums).
